lines.text: Astra on big films: a 25 Mbit/s film starts and seeks about twice as fast on a slow phone, and uses less memory.
Long films: slide your finger up from the seek bar to seek finely.
Dolby and DTS sound is converted away from the page's own thread, so the picture and menus stay smooth.
Seek previews now show on 4K films and on slow connections.
